# heraut skill print

Print the agent skill (SKILL.md) to stdout.

Print the agent skill (SKILL.md) to stdout, to put it wherever your agent reads its instructions.

## Usage

```text
heraut skill print
```

## Examples

```bash
heraut skill print > docs/agents/heraut.md
```

## Global flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--config <string>` |  | path to .heraut.yml (default: auto-discover) |
| `--verbose` |  | echo each command and emit diagnostic logs |
